Fixed at 333: the ryo crates are 0.1.3 (crates/ryo/Cargo.toml:23), an unpublished version, and tastemaker core and cli require 0.1.3, so the [patch.crates-io] paths resolve only unreleased source and a registry build fails to resolve instead of compiling against the wrong API. Risk is low (a std sync primitive, no boundary crossed). The control is Rust's #[cfg(test)], which keeps the counters out of the production build.
